ဘယ်လိုသုံးမလဲ။
ဆံထုံးမှာ ပန်မည်။
ယင်မအုံပါစေနှင့်။
ချမ်း၍ တုန်နေသည်။
တောင်ကုန်းနားက ယုန်ကလေး။
Three jasmine garlands.
How will you use them?
Asked with a smile.
I will wear them in my hair bun.
Various dishes are ready.
Place them all on the table.
Do not let flies swarm them.
Cover them all securely.
It is cold when it is cloudy.
Are the doors shut tight?
Shivering from the cold.
Wrap yourself warmly in a blanket.
The little rabbit near the hill.
Hopping and running away.
If you don't believe, go and ask.
It is unprecedented and truly extraordinary.
စံပယ်ကို ဘယ်နေရာမှာ ပန်မှာလဲ။  --- ဆံထုံးမှာ
ဟင်းတွေကို ဘာမအုံပါစေနဲ့လဲ။  --- ယင်မအုံပါစေနှင့်
ယင်ကောင်တွေ မအုံအောင် ဘယ်လိုလုပ်ထားရမလဲ။  --- အားလုံး လုံအောင် ဖုံးထားပါ
ချမ်းတဲ့အခါ လူက ဘာဖြစ်နေတတ်လဲ။  --- တုန်နေသည်
ချမ်းနေတဲ့သူက စောင်ကို ဘယ်လို ခြုံထားရမလဲ။  --- လုံလုံခြုံထားရမည်
တောင်ကုန်းနားမှာ ဘယ်သူ ရှိနေလဲ။  --- ယုန်ကလေး
ယုန်ကလေးက ဘယ်လိုပုံစံနဲ့ ပြေးနေတာလဲ။  --- ခုန်၍ ခုန်၍ ပြေးသည်
သူများပြောတာကို မယုံရင် ဘာလုပ်ရမလဲ။  --- သွား၍မေးရမည်
How many jasmine garlands are there? --- Three garlands.
How is it asked about the jasmine? --- Asked with a smile.
Where will the jasmine be worn? --- In the hair bun.
What are completely varied now? --- A variety of dishes are ready.
On what are the dishes asked to be placed? --- On the table.
What must not swarm the dishes? --- Do not let flies swarm them.
How should you keep them so flies don't swarm? --- Cover them all securely.
When does it tend to be colder? --- When it is overcast.
What is asked if it's securely shut? --- The door.
What happens to a person when it's cold? --- Shivering.
How should a cold person wrap the blanket? --- Wrap it securely and warmly.
Who is near the hill? --- The little rabbit.
How is the little rabbit running? --- Running by hopping and jumping.
What should you do if you don't believe what others say? --- Go and ask.
